presentation.speaker: imani_cole
presentation.title: Media channel price increase
lines: Channels raised CPM for about two weeks. Pay the higher rates, or pay a fee to lock in half the increase.

choices.label: Pay the higher rates
choices.detail: CPMs rise 30% for two weeks. Adjust the mix to protect your KPIs.
choices.outcome: Channels raised CPM for two weeks. Adjust the mix before the next daily buying cycle.

choices.label: Negotiate a rate lock
choices.detail: Pay $900 to halve the increase for two weeks.
choices.outcome: The channels agreed a locked rate: only half the increase applies for two weeks.
